result.reason: The redline is narrowly tailored and preserves unrelated commercial terms, while appropriately overriding non-refundable payment language to make the refund remedy operative. It does not satisfy the preferred position because it uses shorter warranty periods, limits conformance to material respects, and omits a malicious-code warranty. It also fails the fallback because the material-conformance qualifier is weaker than the required unqualified conformance obligation and no malicious-code protection is included. Drafting concerns also include potential ambiguity in calculating “amounts paid for” deliverables or activities where payments are not itemized.
